evidence.claim: The company serves six fleet sectors: waste collection, highways, construction, cash in transit, transport and logistics, and blue light.
The company's publicly named UK clients include Biffa, FCC Environment, Canenco (Canterbury City Council), Cardtronics and Stratford-on-Avon District Council.
In September 2025 the company and Biffa trialled Binsight, a connected food-waste bin sensor system, for Stratford-on-Avon District Council.
Canenco, which runs Canterbury City Council's environmental services, deployed the company's Defend Connected Live 4G DVR vehicle cameras across its fleet in 2022.

UK Market Share & Penetration.assessed_on: The rating rests on the company's named UK clients across waste, highways and other fleet sectors, including Biffa, FCC Environment and Canenco. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed its total vehicles under management or its UK market share.

evidence.claim: The company reports hardware solutions including the VMC range of video telematics recorders (VMC2, VMC4, and VMC8) supporting 1 to 8 high-definition cameras, GPS/GLONASS receivers, 3-Axis G-Shock sensors, and the VUEtrack standalone telematics unit, according to product literature on the VUE Group Website.

The company reports the integration of VUEscan ultrasonic proximity sensors that connect directly with on-board camera hardware to overlay obstacle location diagrams onto in-cab monitors, according to product specifications on the VUE Group Website.

Hardware & Sensor Integration.assessed_on: The rating rests on the company's documented range of proprietary video recorders, AI human detection cameras, and integrated ultrasonic proximity sensors that cross-compatible with diverse vehicle types. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed independent hardware failure rates, MTBF (mean time between failures) metrics, or specific plug-and-play installation turnaround figures.
